page.overview:
Who is Chef Torte?

Chef Torte is a character and a boss who appears in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars. He is a Terrapin who works as a master chef in Marrymore.

Chef Torte is first seen after Mario and the others sneak into his kitchen trying to stop the wedding of Booster and Princess Toadstool. Chef Torte and his apprentice eventually carry the cake into the wedding room but find out that there is no one to eat the cake. Angry, Chef Torte and his apprentice engage Mario and co. in a battle.

In battle, Chef Torte and his apprentice attack mainly with just charges. However, Chef Torte is a little stronger in his attacks. The main key to this fight is to not attack Chef Torte or his apprentice but their cake. After enough attacks, the cake suddenly starts to move and Chef Torte and his apprentice run away from the battle.
